**Adapted Parallel-RL reaches 59.0% on AIME2025, and Single-Task RL reaches 57.1%**, a gain of +1.9 points (Table 4, p. 6). Both results are for full-parameter GRPO on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B.

Some context from the same table (p. 6):
- The base model scores 49.2% on AIME2025.
- 59.0% is the best AIME2025 score among all 7B methods in the table.
- The +1.9 superscript is the change relative to the corresponding single-task baseline.

For AIME2025, accuracy is reported as avg@16, the average over 16 evaluation runs. This is because the benchmark has relatively few questions (Appendix A.1, p. 13).
